# Gidi

> Gidi is a free web app and an open model that read short, informal Vietnamese personal-finance notes (for example "ăn phở 45k", "nhận lương 15tr", "cho Nam mượn 2 củ", "Long trả 5 lít") and return the transaction type (one of 8), the counterparty (target) span and the amount span. The app turns the amount into VND. Everything runs in the user's browser.

Last updated: 2026-10-06. Site: https://gidi.8bu.dev

## What Gidi is

- Name: Gidi, from "GiaoDịch", Vietnamese for "transaction".
- App title (Vietnamese): "Gidi – Ghi chú chi tiêu tự phân loại, chạy trên máy".
- App title (English): "Gidi – on-device classifier for Vietnamese money notes".
- Input: a short, informal Vietnamese personal-finance note.
- Output: the transaction type (8 types), the counterparty (target) span, and the amount span; the app converts the amount to VND.
- Free, no account. Works on phones and tablets (touch). Light and dark theme. Vietnamese-first.
- Experimental project. It is not financial advice and not a bank or accounting product.

## The 8 transaction types

| Type | Vietnamese label | Meaning | Example note (illustrative) |
|---|---|---|---|
| expense | Chi tiêu | Money spent on goods or fees | `ăn phở 45k` |
| income | Thu nhập | Salary, bonus, sales | `nhận lương 15tr` |
| borrow | Đi vay | You borrow money and must repay it | `mượn Hùng 3tr` |
| lend | Cho vay | You lend money and they repay you | `cho Nam mượn 2 củ` |
| repayment_in | Được trả nợ | Someone repays you | `Long trả 5 lít` |
| repayment_out | Trả nợ | You repay a debt you owe | `trả nợ Lan 500k` |
| transfer | Chuyển tiền | Between your own accounts or wallets only | `chuyển 2tr từ thẻ sang ví` |
| refund | Hoàn tiền | Money back after a cancellation or return | `shop hoàn tiền 150k` |

## Slang amounts understood

Vietnamese money shorthand and slang, with or without diacritics:

| Written as | Value |
|---|---|
| `k`, `nghìn`, `ngàn` | 1,000 VND |
| `tr`, `triệu` | 1,000,000 VND |
| `củ`, `chai` | 1,000,000 VND |
| `xị`, `lít`, `cành` | 100,000 VND |
| `tỏi` | 1,000,000,000 VND |
| `rưỡi` | half of the preceding unit (`2tr rưỡi` = 2,500,000 VND) |
| `1tr2` style | compact form (`1tr2` = 1,200,000 VND) |

## Privacy

- Inference runs fully in the browser with onnxruntime-web (WebAssembly). No note text, name or amount is sent anywhere.
- Notes are stored only in the browser (IndexedDB), with JSON export and import.
- Anonymous, cookieless usage counts (PostHog) record only event counts and event types, never note content.

## Architecture and model

- Model: `gidi-finance-v3`, release 3.0.0.
- One INT8 encoder predicts the transaction type and the target span; a rule-based value parser finds and converts the amount.
- Bundle: 29.3 MB INT8 ONNX.
- Speed: about 1.4 ms p50 per note on one CPU thread.
- Runtime: onnxruntime-web (WASM), in the browser.

## Accuracy

Test set `human-value-02`: 190 notes, labelled by two LLM labellers with adjudication and approved by the author.

| Metric | v3 (current) | v2 (previous) |
|---|---|---|
| Transaction type | 92.1% | not reported here |
| Target (counterparty) | 85.3% | not reported here |
| Value (amount) | 100% | not reported here |
| End-to-end exact | 78.9% | 59.5% |
| Model size | 29.3 MB | 58.1 MB |

## Training data

About 1,000 generated raw notes, reviewed by a human and labelled in Quet (https://github.com/8bu/quet). Human labels are authoritative.

## Limitations

- Known weak spots: multi-word shop names; the who-pays meaning of `trả` (a friend repaying you versus an employer paying you); gift receivers.
- The test set has 190 notes, so the figures are indicative.
- Vietnamese-first. Offline use is not a promised feature: the page and the model bundle must be downloaded first.
